newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 4,035 to dollar for Dec 27-Jan 5 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 4,035 to dollar for Dec 27-Jan 5 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 4,035 to the dollar for December 27 to 31 and for January 1 to 5, 1997.
This reference rate was set on Monday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
December 30 and 31, as well as January 3 are public holidays. December 25 and 26 and January 1 and 2 are also public holidays under the law. In Romania, the market observes public holidays.
The leu's reference rate set on Friday for December 24 to 26 is 3,914 to the dollar. It was 3,914 on Monday.
